title: 40 Kubernetes Interview Questions for DevOps and SRE
summary: The 40 most-asked Kubernetes interview questions for DevOps/SRE roles, grouped into themed pages. They run from architecture, pods, workloads, services, config and storage through scheduling, probes, autoscaling, RBAC and networking, then end with troubleshooting scenarios and a closing cheatsheet.

chapters.title: Kubernetes Interview Q&A
points: 40 most asked Kubernetes interview questions for DevOps and SRE roles
10 themed pages of 4 questions each, ordered from fundamentals to scenarios
Covers architecture, workloads, services, config, storage, scheduling, autoscaling, security and networking
Ends with troubleshooting scenarios and a one-page kubectl cheatsheet

chapters.title: Architecture and Control Plane
points: What are the components of the Kubernetes control plane and what does each one do?
What happens, step by step, when you run kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml?
What is etcd and why does its health matter so much?
What is the difference between control plane components and worker node components?

chapters.title: Pods
points: What is a Pod and why is it the smallest deployable unit instead of a container?
What is the difference between init containers and sidecar containers?
What are the Pod lifecycle phases and how do they differ from container states?
How does a Pod shut down gracefully (SIGTERM, terminationGracePeriodSeconds, preStop)?

chapters.title: Deployments and ReplicaSets
points: What is the difference between a Pod, a ReplicaSet and a Deployment?
How does a rolling update work and what do maxSurge and maxUnavailable control?
How do you roll back a bad Deployment and how is revision history kept?
What is the difference between a Deployment, a StatefulSet and a DaemonSet?

chapters.title: Services and Ingress
points: What is the difference between ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer and ExternalName Services?
How does a Service find its Pods and route traffic to them (selectors, Endpoints, kube-proxy)?
What is the difference between an Ingress and a LoadBalancer Service?
What is a headless Service and when would you use one?

chapters.title: ConfigMaps and Secrets
points: What is the difference between a ConfigMap and a Secret?
Are Kubernetes Secrets actually secure?
What is the difference between injecting config as env vars and mounting it as files, and what happens on update?
How do you manage secrets safely in production (encryption at rest, External Secrets, Sealed Secrets)?

chapters.title: Volumes and Persistent Storage
points: What is the difference between emptyDir, hostPath and a PersistentVolume?
How do PersistentVolume, PersistentVolumeClaim and StorageClass work together?
What are access modes and reclaim policies, and how do they affect your data?
How do StatefulSets give Pods stable identity and storage?

chapters.title: Scheduling
points: How does the scheduler decide which node a Pod runs on (filtering and scoring)?
What is the difference between nodeSelector, node affinity and pod anti-affinity?
What are taints and tolerations and how are they different from affinity?
What is the difference between resource requests and limits, and what are QoS classes?

chapters.title: Probes and Autoscaling
points: What is the difference between liveness, readiness and startup probes?
How does the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler calculate the desired replica count?
What is the difference between HPA, VPA and the Cluster Autoscaler?
What happens when a container exceeds its memory limit versus its CPU limit?

chapters.title: RBAC and Networking
points: How does RBAC work: what is the difference between Role, ClusterRole, RoleBinding and ClusterRoleBinding?
What is a ServiceAccount and how do Pods use it to talk to the API server?
How do NetworkPolicies work and what happens when none are defined?
How does Pod-to-Pod networking work and what does a CNI plugin do?

chapters.title: Troubleshooting Scenarios
points: A Pod is stuck in CrashLoopBackOff. How do you debug it?
A Pod is stuck in Pending. What do you check?
A Service is not reachable from other Pods. How do you troubleshoot it?
A worker node goes NotReady. What happens to its Pods and what do you do?

chapters.title: Kubernetes Interview Cheatsheet
points: Inspect: kubectl get / describe / logs / events, plus -o wide and -o yaml
Debug: kubectl logs --previous, exec -it, debug, port-forward
Rollouts: kubectl rollout status / history / undo, set image, scale
Control plane chain: API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager, kubelet
Service types at a glance: ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, ExternalName, headless
Probe rule of thumb: liveness restarts, readiness gates traffic, startup protects slow boot
Scheduling levers: requests, nodeSelector, affinity, taints and tolerations
Pod status to cause map: Pending, CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, OOMKilled, Evicted
